output.summary: A biennial plant originating from the region between central Europe and Asia. It has delicately divided leaves and clusters of small white to pale-violet flowers. Its cooked roots, tender leaves and fruits are eaten, while the spicy, slightly sweet seeds flavour breads, cheeses, drinks and other foods.
output.edibilityNote: Cooked roots are eaten as a vegetable; tender leaves, fruits and seeds are used in salads, dishes, baked goods, cheeses and drinks.
